description: This PHP file serves as a routing script for a web application, handling requests and serving static font files with different MIME types based on the file extension. It also sets the script name to a default index if the requested file doesn't exist.

methods.name: anonymous function
methods.description: The main anonymous function handles determining if a requested static file exists and serves it with the correct MIME type. It also modifies the script name to point to a default index.
